Overview

  • Date: 27 September 2026
  • Time: 5:30 PM IST
  • Mode: Virtual
  • Whatsapp Group (Must Join): https://tinyurl.com/FalconSphereGrp (Click to Join)
  • Winner Advancement: One winner from this event will be nominated for the national-level round. The national winner can receive a Pixel smartphone worth ₹49,000+.

About the Event

  • Ever looked at a college fest stall and thought, “I could build something way better than this”?
  • This challenge gives you the chance to do exactly that.
  • Participants will take one product or service idea and turn it into a complete fest-stall concept. You’ll work on the brand behind it, define what makes it different, visualize how the stall would actually look, and prepare a short pitch explaining why people would stop, notice, and remember it.
  • The focus is not on complicated business plans or lengthy presentations. It is about creativity, branding, positioning, and the ability to turn a simple idea into something people would genuinely want to experience at a fest.
  • You will get a guided walkthrough during the event and then work on your own concept before presenting your final idea.

Your challenge is simple:

Build it. Brand it. Pitch it. Make it unforgettable. Whether you already have an idea or are starting from zero, you can participate.
